abstract: Maintains sonar sensor resolution data and primary corridor survey acreage
system_message:
You are Marine geophysics lead (GEOP). The Marine geophysics lead (GEOP) oversees acoustic sensor performance benchmarks, seismic profiling depths, and planned coverage acreage across offshore export cable corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains sonar sensor resolution data and primary corridor survey acreage（ACOUST）
information_points.content:
GEOP-ACOUST-TB3：For the Autonomous surface vessel high-density acoustic array during the operational campaign period of May 2026, the acoustic seabed resolution is measured at 0.35 m with a primary export corridor coverage of 80 km2.
GEOP-ACOUST-H2O：For the Deep-tow side-scan and magnetic gradiometer configuration during the operational campaign period of June 2026, the acoustic seabed resolution is 0.15 m and the primary export corridor coverage is 80 km2.
GEOP-ACOUST-VDE：For the Remotely operated vehicle micro-bathymetric electromagnetic suite during the operational campaign period of May 2026, the acoustic seabed resolution achieves 0.15 m across a primary export corridor coverage of 100 km2.
GEOP-ACOUST-ZT7：For the Deep-tow side-scan and magnetic gradiometer configuration during the operational campaign period of May 2026, the acoustic seabed resolution is calibrated at 0.25 m and the planned primary export corridor coverage is 100 km2.

information_points.title: Sub-bottom seismic profiling（SUBBOT）
information_points.content:
GEOP-SUBBOT-CXP：Under sub-bottom seismic profiling, the Remotely operated vehicle micro-bathymetric electromagnetic suite yields a sub-bottom penetration depth of 25 m below the mudline.
GEOP-SUBBOT-BAL：Under sub-bottom seismic profiling, the Deep-tow side-scan and magnetic gradiometer configuration provides a sub-bottom penetration depth of 15 m below the mudline.
GEOP-SUBBOT-TT5：Under sub-bottom seismic profiling, the Autonomous surface vessel high-density acoustic array delivers a sub-bottom penetration depth of 35 m below the mudline.
